name: quiz-muscle.jpg

usage: Plant or Animal quiz, photograph 2 - answer ANIMAL. Long soft fibres, dark nuclei, no straight walls.

usage: Plant or Animal quiz, photograph 3 - answer PLANT. The trap: purple, no chloroplasts, but unmistakable straight walls. Kept at its native 795px; the original is no larger.

usage: Plant or Animal quiz, photograph 4 - answer ANIMAL. The big cell with the purple middle is a white blood cell.
